headline: Brown-Forman B (BF.B) Surges 5.5%: Is This an Indication of Further Gains?
summary: Brown-Forman B (BF.B) witnessed a jump in share price last session on above-average trading volume. The latest trend in earnings estimate revisions for the stock doesn't suggest further strength down the road.
